deep.reconstruction: There is no mathematics on this page. It is an archival cover or label sheet in Latin cursive, written in the third person about Riemann ('R.'), so it is almost certainly by a later editor or archivist and not by Riemann himself. It reads: 'Vita. / Entwurf des Anschreibens an den Dekan, / in welchem R. um Zulassung zur Doctorpromotion / bittet' (Vita. Draft of the covering letter to the Dean, in which R. asks for admission to the doctoral promotion). A pencil folio number '55' appears at the upper right. It belongs with the materials for Riemann's 1851 Göttingen doctorate. The previous page holds draft fragments related to the dissertation (a function of z fixed by boundary or discontinuity data, the minimum of Omega, Dirichlet-principle-type reasoning). The sheet presumably marked where the Vita and the draft letter to the Dean of the Philosophical Faculty were filed; those documents are not reproduced on this page. There are no derivations to reconstruct.
